payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results achieved by the model Jasper on various datasets, including WER percentages.

claims.text: The model Jasper achieved a state-of-the-art WER of 2.95% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder.
Jasper achieved a WER of 3.86% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a greedy decoder.
Competitive results were reported on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
Jasper obtained state-of-the-art results on LibriSpeech test-other among end-to-end models.
Using greedy decoding without a language model, Jasper achieved 3.86% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean.
